questions.question: The pre-run's act part read G-DELETES-ONE-BRANCH's positive control passing (data/b758_arms_prerun_act.txt :26), and close.py dry refused the seal on it, nothing recorded (data/b758_close_dry.txt :3). The arm's plant (tools/standing/allow.py plant_kept) turns to kept the first delete clause that covers the named refs, which is (R368)(2)'s clause for the relay's and PLACE-papers' push-b757-* branches; (R368)(5)'s clause deleting the kernels' push-b757-* and push-b758-* branches still allows the same names, the reader not reading the repository, so the planted copy passes. A read-only scratch reader over the rulings of b724 to b758: b758 alone carries two delete clauses over its named refs, and a plant turning every covering clause to kept fails as wanted at b758 and reads as before at the other 34. The live verdict stands, each delete one branch and allowed by (2)'s clause. Every route past the refusal writes after the lock gate, which N4 scores (no bank, face or tool is edited after the lock gate); b724 met this arm at its seal and took the author's word (data/b724_events.txt :50). Which route?

options.label: Repair the act's plant, then seal (Recommended)
options.description: One Edit of tools/acts/b758.py after the lock: an override of the arm's plant turning every delete clause that covers the named refs to kept, not the first alone, its control the scratch reader's 35 rulings. N4 reads REFUTED on this edit and is printed so, as at b724. Then the pre-run's act part again, the combine, the seconds, close.py dry, the post-lock scan and the seal. The standing repair of plant_kept carried to the next act's opening.

options.label: Repair the standing reader
options.description: tools/standing/allow.py plant_kept made to plant every covering clause, VERSION moved, its controls the 35 rulings, by the Edit tool after the lock, a standing change (R368) does not order. N4 reads REFUTED on this edit. Then the same runs again and the seal.

options.label: Stop before the seal, carry
options.description: Nothing edited and the seal not taken; steps [8] to [25] carried to the next ruling, as b757 carried [22] to [25], with the plant's repair for that ruling to order. SIDE-explicit-formula's main and its tags v0.39 and v0.40 stand as landed; the relay's and PLACE-papers' commits of this act stay unpushed until the close runs.
